events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Theme Tunes
angles.copy: From Shirley Bassey to Billie Eilish, which Bond theme tune gets your vote as the ultimate 007 anthem?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite moment from his incredible career, from Python to Fawlty Towers?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Tracks
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles dropped 'The White Album'. Which track from this legendary double LP is on repeat for you?

events.title: Freddie Mercury Remembered
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day in 1991. His voice and showmanship remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: A masterpiece turns another year older! The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' dropped on this day in 1965, changing the game with its innovative sound.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of The Beatles' John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Message
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, a visionary artist whose message of peace and love continues to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie, an icon of music and style, was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Influence
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today, leaving behind an unparalleled legacy of music and artistry.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935 in Tupelo, Mississippi.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: All shook up for Elvis! The King would have been 92 today, and his music still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page! What's your favourite riff from the Led Zeppelin maestro?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British rock and pop icon Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! An incredible career spanning decades of hits. What's your favourite Rod tune?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Forever bringing the house down with those iconic tunes.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday today.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! What's your favourite track from the 80s hitmaker?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Dolly Parton! A true force of nature, what's your go-to Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Barlow's Hits
angles.copy: Wishing Gary Barlow a very happy 56th birthday! From Take That anthems to solo ballads, what's your favourite track penned by Gary?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday today.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean! Which of his timeless hits gets you dancing?
